# Tuteliq CLI

> Command-line interface for Tuteliq: detect bullying, grooming, unsafe content, fraud and more from your terminal.

## What is this?
A CLI tool for the Tuteliq child safety API. Scan text, conversations, audio, images and video for harmful content, run hosted age and identity verification sessions, and review incidents directly from the terminal. Requires Node.js 22.12 or later.

## Install
npm install -g @tuteliq/cli
# or
brew tap Tuteliq/tap && brew install tuteliq

## Quick Start
tuteliq login tq_your_key
tuteliq detect-unsafe "message to check"
tuteliq detect-bullying "you're so ugly"
tuteliq detect-grooming -m '[{"role":"adult","content":"..."},{"role":"child","content":"..."}]' --age 12
tuteliq usage monthly

## Commands
- tuteliq analyze <text>: Quick safety analysis (bullying + unsafe)
- tuteliq detect-unsafe <text>: Scan text for harmful content
- tuteliq detect-bullying <text>: Detect bullying patterns
- tuteliq detect-grooming -m <json>: Analyze conversations for grooming
- tuteliq detect-social-engineering | detect-app-fraud | detect-romance-scam | detect-mule-recruitment <text>: Fraud detection
- tuteliq detect-gambling-harm | detect-coercive-control | detect-vulnerability-exploitation | detect-radicalisation | detect-distress-signals <text>: Extended safety detection
- tuteliq detect-synthetic-text <text>: Detect AI-generated text
- tuteliq analyse-multi <text> -e <list>: Several detections in one request
- tuteliq emotions <text> / tuteliq action-plan <situation>: Analysis and guidance
- tuteliq voice <file> / tuteliq image <file> / tuteliq analyze-video <file>: Media analysis
- tuteliq verify session create [--mode age|identity] [--document-type passport|national_id|drivers_license] [--chip-policy optional|required|instead_of_photo] [--no-auto-capture]: Create a hosted verification session (POST /api/v1/verify/session) and print the URL for the user
- tuteliq verify session get <id> [--json]: Session status (including document_required) and result, with face match score (GET /api/v1/verify/session/:id)
- tuteliq verify session cancel <id>: Cancel a session (DELETE /api/v1/verify/session/:id)
- tuteliq incidents list | get <id> | overview | trends: Read incidents (GET /api/v1/incidents)
- tuteliq incidents review <id> / batch-review <ids...>: Record moderator decisions (POST /api/v1/incidents/:id/review, /api/v1/incidents/batch-review)
- tuteliq webhook list | create | update | delete | test | regenerate-secret: Webhook management
- tuteliq account export | delete | consent-record | consent-status | consent-withdraw | audit-logs: Account data (GDPR)
- tuteliq pricing / tuteliq usage monthly | history | by-tool: Pricing and usage
- tuteliq breach ...: Admin only (requires an admin key; ordinary API keys receive 403)

## Supported Languages
32 languages: English (stable), Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Italian, Turkish, Romanian, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Slovenian, Maltese, Irish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian (beta). Auto-detected, no configuration needed.
